camel_example: aliyun dbs ModifyBackupSourceEndpoint --region cn-hangzhou --BackupPlanId dbs1h0000usfa --SourceEndpointInstanceType RDS
description_en: Modify a DBS backup source endpoint
description_zh: 该接口用于修改数据库备份源
kebab_example: aliyun dbs modify-backup-source-endpoint --backup-plan-id dbs1h0000usfa --source-endpoint-instance-type RDS --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyBackupSourceEndpoint

parameters.help_en: The backup plan ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to get this value
parameters.help_zh: 备份计划ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the source instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to get this value. Valid values:

RDS: an RDS instance

ECS: a self-managed database on an ECS instance

Express: a database connected over a leased line, VPN Gateway, or Smart Access Gateway

Agent: a database connected over a backup gateway

DDS: an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance

Other: a database connected over an IP address and port
parameters.help_zh:
数据库所在位置，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。取值如下：

RDS
ECS
Express：通过专线/VPN网关/智能网关接入的数据库
Agent：通过备份网关接入的数据库
DDS：云MongoDB
Other：通过IP:Port直连的数据库
parameters.name: source_endpoint_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The database region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to get this value.

This parameter is required if the SourceEndpointInstanceType parameter is set to `RDS`, `ECS`, `DDS`, `Express`, or `Agent`
parameters.help_zh:
数据库地域，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

SourceEndpointInstanceType为RDS、ECS、DDS、Express、Agent时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_region

parameters.help_en:
The database instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to get this value.

This parameter is required if the SourceEndpointInstanceType parameter is set to `RDS`, `ECS`, `DDS`, or `Express`
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

SourceEndpointInstanceType为RDS、ECS、DDS、Express时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to get this value.

This parameter is required if the SourceEndpointInstanceType parameter is set to `Express`, `Agent`, or `Other`
parameters.help_zh:
数据库连接地址，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

SourceEndpointInstanceType为Express、Agent、Other时该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_ip

parameters.help_en:
The database port. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to get this value.

This parameter is required if the SourceEndpointInstanceType parameter is set to `Express`, `Agent`, `Other`, or `ECS`
parameters.help_zh:
数据库端口，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

SourceEndpointInstanceType为Express、Agent、Other、ECS，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_port

parameters.help_en:
The database name.

This parameter is required for PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases.

This parameter is also required for Microsoft SQL Server databases when the SourceEndpointInstanceType parameter is set to 'Agent'
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称。

数据库类型为PostgreSQL、MongoDB时，该参数必传。
数据库所在位置为Agent且数据库类型为MSSQL时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_database_name

parameters.help_en:
The username of the database account. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to get this value.

This parameter is required for all database engines except for Redis and Microsoft SQL Server (when the SourceEndpointInstanceType parameter is set to 'Agent')
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

数据库类型为Redis，或者数据库所在位置为Agent且数据库类型为MSSQL时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_user_name

parameters.help_en:
The password for the database account.

This parameter is required for all database engines except for Redis and Microsoft SQL Server (when the SourceEndpointInstanceType parameter is set to 'Agent')
parameters.help_zh:
密码。

数据库类型为Redis，或者数据库所在位置为Agent且数据库类型为MSSQL时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_password

parameters.help_en:
The backup gateway ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to get this value.

This parameter is required if the SourceEndpointInstanceType parameter is set to `Agent`
parameters.help_zh:
备份网关ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

SourceEndpointInstanceType为Agent时，该参数必传
parameters.name: backup_gateway_id

parameters.example: [{  "DBName":"待备份库名", "SchemaName":"待备份 Schema 名", "TableIncludes":[{ "TableName":"待备份表表名" }],  "TableExcludes":[{"TableName":"待备份库名不需要备份表的表名" }] } ]
parameters.help_en: Backup objects: This parameter is optional if the database is located on an agent, but required for all other scenarios. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 备份对象，当数据库所在位置为Agent时，该参数非必须，其他场景均必传。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: backup_objects

parameters.help_en: The Oracle SID. This parameter is required for Oracle databases
parameters.help_zh: Oracle SID名称，数据库类型为Oracle时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_oracle_sid

parameters.help_en: The RAM role name for cross-account backup
parameters.help_zh: 跨阿里云账号备份的RAM角色名称
parameters.name: cross_role_name

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token to ensure request idempotence
parameters.help_zh: 任意字符串，用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use an SSL connection to back up the source database
parameters.help_zh: 是否通过SSL安全连接备份源数据库实例
parameters.name: enable_source_endpoint_ssl

parameters.help_en: The PEM certificate for the SSL connection
parameters.name: ssl_ca_pem

ErrMessage.example: The specified parameter %s value is not valid.

NeedPrecheck.description_en: Indicates whether the modification triggers a precheck. If this parameter is set to true, you must call the StartBackupPlan operation to start the backup plan
NeedPrecheck.description_zh: 本次修改是否会触发预检查，如果为true则需要再调用StartBackupPlan接口启动备份计划

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
